panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Panel (a) fundus photography from gyrate atrophy case report article shows confluent peripheral chorioretinal atrophy described in caption and in-text as gyrate atrophy manifestation. B: Panel (b) autofluorescence from same gyrate atrophy patient shows hypoautofluorescence matching atrophic zones, vocabulary-defined finding. C: Panel (c) OCT shows multiple intraretinal cystic spaces with preservation of outer retinal layers including ellipsoid zone. No vocabulary finding_key matches this (vocabulary OCT term requires outer retinal and choroidal atrophy/ellipsoid loss, opposite of described preservation); per rule 6 no finding can be named from vocabulary so panel excluded despite same-disease patient image.

panels.context: Fundus photography and autofluorescence show confluent chorioretinal atrophy in the peripheral retina and around the arcade vessels in the right eye. Optical coherence tomography shows multiple intraretinal cystic spaces with preservation of the outer retinal layers.

source_variant.context_summary: Fundus photography and autofluorescence show confluent chorioretinal atrophy in the peripheral retina and around the arcade vessels in the right eye. Optical coherence tomography shows multiple intraretinal cystic spaces with preservation of the outer retinal layers.
source_variant.figure_caption: Multimodal retinal imaging findings. (a) Fundus photography reveals confluent chorioretinal atrophy in the peripheral retina as well as around the arcade vessels (superiorly in the right eye). (b) Fundus autofluorescence imaging demonstrates hypoautofluorescence corresponding to the areas of chorioretinal atrophy. (c) Optical coherence tomography reveals multiple intraretinal cystic spaces with preservation of the outer retinal layers, including the ellipsoid zone.
